messages:
Lina T.: quick note - observed resume token namespace collision after a routing rebalancer changed shard id format. client resume_token 'sh-12-abcd' -> server parses 'sh-12' as shard but now new format 'sh.v2-12' mismatches -> resume rejected.
Mason K.: ugh. did rebalance change token parsing? we intended tokens opaque.
Olga R.: router logs show token split on '-' and we used the first part as shard id. change slipped in when we added human-readable tokens.
Lina T.: mitigation: make token parsing opaque again. also we should have a unit test for token churn.
deploy-bot: hotfix applied to router parsing -> staging -> success
Mason K.: add console badge: "token-format-change" on route config to warn if you opt into human tokens.
Olga R.: will add test. done.
